scope.purpose: Record the existing source-bound candidate, formal local adjudication, and fresh sealed benchmark contract before a small trial.

required_values.projection_policy: bounded page prefix, <=12000 bytes per page and <=32000 bytes total

candidate_contract.source_provenance_rule: A Luna may select or arrange an existing page-authored RQ candidate, but a Luna-authored query must not be relabeled source=recall_questions without a contract change.

search_label_artifact.approved_label_rule: review decision=approved and expected_pages/negative_pages/stale_pages exactly equal the candidate buckets
search_label_artifact.authority_rule: authority and current runtime router epoch must compare equal

answer_adjudication_receipt.required_decision: approved with all four boolean safeguards true
answer_adjudication_receipt.reference_independence_meaning: Reference evidence is source-projected and does not reuse a production answer or field-on/off outcome; it does not require three judge models.
answer_adjudication_receipt.artifact_integrity: DecisionArtifactStore seal, execution fingerprint, authority epoch, and hash-chained receipt must validate.

current_authority.interpretation: Luna generation and formal local Qwen adjudication are different stages; current single-model authority is sufficient for this contract.

sealed_split_contract.leakage_rule: page_id/page_uid/content_sha256 connected components remain within one split; predecessor split identities are inherited
sealed_split_contract.evaluation_separation: source packet is frozen before evaluation; production answer and field outcome are forbidden inputs
sealed_split_contract.manual94_rule: Do not re-split the existing manual94 manifest.

human_review_boundary.user_judgment_required: Only if choosing the human_review gold path or if machine adjudication returns a deterministic auth/oauth/quota/keychain/secret-store boundary. Ordinary label ambiguity is held/retried, not silently converted to user approval.

small_trial_contract.write_scope: isolated trial ledger and DecisionArtifactStore only; no search-golden or production benchmark pointer
small_trial_contract.preflight: Run adjudicate_machine_search_label_candidates(..., dry_run=True) and inspect only status/pending/stale counts before allowing model calls.
small_trial_contract.postflight: Validate the trial chain and each receipt against its source packet; run build_machine_answer_benchmark_epoch(..., dry_run=True) to inspect split counts.

blockers: Current answer-consensus ledger has no receipts.
A 20-receipt trial is not yet a promotion-ready benchmark; train and locked-test cluster floors must be met in a fresh epoch.
Only page-authored recall_questions candidates satisfy the existing machine packet contract; arbitrary Luna-authored queries need a separate source kind/contract.
